newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq suffers further losses, drops 2.22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq suffers further losses, drops 2.22 pct.

text.p: Interest rate fears continued to batter stocks, pushing Nasdaq shares down to their lowest level since November 4.

The Nasdaq Composite Index dropped 27.79 points or 2.22 percent to 1221.72. Declining issues doubled the number of gainers on total volume of almost 593 million. The Dow industrials fell 157 points to 6583.
"Everything was down across the board. It's just the continuation of the weakness we've been seeing lately," said Patrick Davis, head of over-the-counter trading at Salomon Brothers.
"Investors are reluctant to jump in and buy with interest rate fears looming ahead. Many are staying on the sidelines waiting for more direction on where things are likely to go," one trader said.

Ascend Communications Inc led the Nasdaq decline, falling 11-1/4 to 40-3/4 after it agreed to acquire Cascade Communications Corp in a stock deal valued at about $3.7 billion. Cascade fell 2 to 26-3/8.
Alkermes Inc dropped 6-1/4 to 14 after it said a clinical trial fell short of expectations. Shiva Corp also slipped about 25 percent after an earnings warning.
